generated_grammar_imports: Level L runtime modules, emitted by Level L; both grammars are table providers, not G compiler products
runtime_boundary: C/G source-to-IR executes the linked B/L frontend image directly in each VM. No rxc/rxc-c/rxcc_lib/rxclib/native compiler reader is linked or spawned. Native rxc/rxas/rxlink prepare host bytecode only. The existing VM and B library are native/runtime prerequisites. The full Classic package retains its G build prerequisite but is read only as metadata.
